verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw is a full-service Indian law firm, not a software product or tool, so opting out of product telemetry and usage tracking does not fit this kind of offering. Its Data Protection & Privacy practice advises clients on compliance; that is a legal service, not a user-facing telemetry opt-out, and it does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
